"""Bad: hash and JWT cracking (LINT-08)."""
import hashcat


def crack_jwt(token):
    return hashcat.HashCat(token)


def run(self, entity, ctx):
    ctx.net.run_tool("john", ["--wordlist=words.txt", "hashes.txt"], targets=[])
    return ctx.http.get("https://crackstation.net/?hash=" + entity.value)
